disposition: satellite_match_valid=False rows are NEVER discarded; they participate in tiering with the satellite dimension absorbed (see Phase 9)
join_rule: exact (lat7, lon7, year, season, crop_label) match to frozen corpus rows, then record_id join to the R5.6 image_stats export
satellite_status: recovered observations have no local imagery; their satellite feature columns are empty until a Kaggle export of the R5.7 pool is produced with scripts/kaggle_r5_7_image_stats.py
